metadata.title: SUNACS — Sudanese National Committee for Space
metadata.description: The Sudanese National Committee for Space (SUNACS) leads Sudan's national space policy, the SuSat-1 remote sensing satellite, the national ground segment and international space partnerships.

hero.description: SUNACS builds the national road map for space, adapting space technologies to serve Sudan's development, security and public services.

about.label: WHO WE ARE
about.title: Our Objectives
about.subtitle: The Sudanese National Committee for Space (SUNACS) leads Sudan's national space effort, from policy to satellites.
items: Build a strong road map for the national space plan.
Adapt space technologies and capabilities to serve the country's programs.
Design, develop and implement space systems within the national space program.
Involve the domestic industry in the related fields of space technology.
Support and develop the country's activities.
Develop the space sector's research, development and manufacturing capabilities.

policies.label: SUDAN SPACE POLICIES
policies.title: National Space Policy
policies.subtitle: Seven policies set out how Sudan uses space to serve its people.

items.title: Natural Resources Utilization by Space Applications
items.reason: To get the maximum benefit from local resources, new technologies are needed.
items.statement: Sudan shall use space applications and activities to explore, manage and monitor its resources in order to use them effectively.

items.title: Achieve Prosperity, Improve Living Standards and Develop Public Services
items.reason: To use space projects to ease citizens' lives and monitor overall development.
items.statement: Sudan shall make maximum use of space applications to promote good governance and improve public services.

items.title: National Security and Development
items.reason: As a rich country, Sudan needs a way to secure its borders, territorial waters and lands.
items.statement: Sudan shall focus on space applications that preserve and enhance the country's national security, to promote development that benefits its people.

items.title: Capacity Building in Space Industry and Applications
items.reason: To sustain space projects in the country, a robust industry must be established to make and use space products and their derivatives.
items.statement: Sudan will create a robust and active space industry and service provision to support the space program, through public-private partnership and cooperation.

items.title: Enhance International Cooperation and Partnerships
items.reason: A developing country such as Sudan lacks the resources to develop its own space technology effectively, and will address this through cooperation and partnership with space-faring countries.
items.statement: Sudan shall actively seek international partnerships and collaborations so that it becomes a relevant member of the global scientific space community, providing significant contributions and capabilities in space science and technology applications.

items.title: Space Research and Development
items.reason: Derivative technologies from space research have been shown to benefit the advancement of society and a country's economy.
items.statement: Sudan shall focus on research and development in vital areas of space science, technology and allied fields, producing published papers and patents that benefit the scientific field and society.

items.title: Space Education and Awareness
items.reason: A significant number of local experts in the space industry is needed to sustain a space program.
items.statement: Sudan shall establish a sustainable pool of scientists, engineers and communicators for the country's future space program, and increase public awareness of its value and benefits through programs with universities and colleges that teach space science and technology.

program.label: NATIONAL SPACE PROGRAM
program.title: A program built on the country's needs

items.title: Bottom line
items.intro: The national space program shall serve the country's needs.
points: The country's needs shall be identified first
Identify the needs that can be met, even partially, by space utilization
Develop space solutions for each identified need

items.title: Space program shall be sustainable
items.intro: To be able to answer the country's needs in the future.

items.title: Framework to guarantee a sustainable program
items.intro: A domestic space ecosystem for sustainability.
